call.code:
import csv, os
root = os.environ["PANTHEON_PROJECTS"]; P = lambda r: os.path.join(root, r)
orders = list(csv.DictReader(open(P("sales/orders.csv"), newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig")))
customers = {r["customer_id"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(P("crm/customers.csv"), newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig"))}
out, dropped, conflicts = [], {}, []
for o in orders:
    try: total = float(o["total"])
    except ValueError: dropped["total not a number"] = dropped.get("total not a number", 0) + 1; continue
    c = customers.get(o["customer_id"])
    if c is None: dropped["no such customer"] = dropped.get("no such customer", 0) + 1; continue
    if o.get("region") and o["region"] != c["region"]: conflicts.append((o["customer_id"], o["region"], c["region"]))
    out.append({"date": o["date"], "customer_id": o["customer_id"], "region": c["region"], "total": total})
lost = sum(v for k, v in dropped.items() if k != "total not a number")
print("in", len(orders), len(customers), "out", len(out), "dropped", dropped, "conflicts", conflicts)
if lost > 0.01 * len(orders): print("STOP"); raise SystemExit
target = P("reports/orders_by_region.csv"); dest = target + ".new" if os.path.exists(target) else target
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target), exist_ok=True)
w = csv.DictWriter(open(dest, "w", newline=""), ["date", "customer_id", "region", "total"]); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(out)
print("wrote", os.path.relpath(dest, root))
